summary_en: The proper calendar of the Latin Patriarchate of Jerusalem (Hierosolymitani Latinorum, listed under 'Conferentiae episcoporum') is approved; the Patriarchate spans Israel, Palestine, Jordan and Cyprus, so no single nation code applies.
excerpt: Hierosolymitani Latinorum : Calendarium proprium (1 nov. 2022; Prot. 581/22).

summary_en: For the Democratic Republic of the Congo the optional memorial of Blessed Isidore Bakanja, martyr (12 August), in the proper calendar is henceforth celebrated as a memorial in all dioceses. The date is printed as 21 nov. 2020 although the protocol is 417/22 (a probable misprint for 2022); recorded as printed.
excerpt: Reipublicae Democraticae Congensis: 12 augusti, Memoria ad libitum beati Isidori Bakanja, martyris in Calendario proprio gradu memoriae ex nunc in omnibus dioecesibus celebratur (21 nov. 2020; Prot. 417/22).

summary_en: The proper calendar of the diocese of Cartagena (Carthaginiensis in Hispania, Spain) is approved.
excerpt: Carthaginiensis in Hispania, Hispania: Calendarium proprium (11 iul. 2022; Prot. 652/21).

summary_en: The proper calendar of the diocese of Alcalá de Henares (Complutensis, Spain) is approved.
excerpt: Complutensis, Hispania: Calendarium proprium (24 maii 2022; Prot. 611/21).

summary_en: For the diocese of Bolzano-Bressanone (Bauzanensis-Brixinensis, Italy) three transfers are granted: the optional memorials of Sts Pontian, pope, and Hippolytus, priest, martyrs, and of Blessed Jakob Gapp, priest and martyr, from 13 to 12 August; the solemnity of Sts Cassian, martyr, and Vigilius, bishop and martyr, patrons of the diocese, from the Saturday of the second week of Easter to 13 August; and the solemnity of the Dedication of all churches whose date is unknown from the Saturday before the third Sunday of October to 25 October.
excerpt: Bauzanensis-Brixinensis, Italia: translatio memoriarum ad libitum sanctorum Pontiani, papae, et Hippolyti, presbyteri, martyrum, atque beati Iacobi Gapp, presbyteri et martyris, a die 13 augusti ad diem 12 eiusdem mensis; sollemnitatis sanctorum Cassiani, martyris, et Vergilii, episcopi et martyris, Patronorum dioecesis a Sabbato hebdomadae II Paschae ad diem 13 augusti; sollemnitatis in Dedicatione omnium ecclesiarum, cuius dies est ignotus, a Sabbato ante Dominicam III octobris ad diem 25 octobris (21 dec. 2022; Prot. 490/22).

summary_en: For the diocese of Belluno-Feltre (Bellunensis-Feltrensis, Italy) the optional memorial of Blessed John Paul I, pope, is granted on 26 August. The date is printed as 30 nov. 2020 although the protocol is 373/22 and the same protocol is dated 30 nov. 2022 in the text-approval section on p. 434 (a probable misprint); recorded as printed.
excerpt: Bellunensis-Feltrensis, Italia: 26 augusti, beati Ioannis I, papae, memoria ad libitum (30 nov. 2020; Prot. 373/22).

excerpt: translatio celebrationis memoriae ad libitum sancti Zephyrini, papae et martyris, a die 26 ad diem 25 augusti (18 nov. 2022; Prot. 580/22).

summary_en: For the archdiocese of Warsaw (Varsaviensis, Poland) Saint Ephrem, deacon and doctor of the Church, is transferred from 9 to 10 June and Saint Hildegard of Bingen, virgin and doctor of the Church, from 17 to 19 September (same protocol as the Czacka concession).
excerpt: translatio sancti Ephraem, diaconi et Ecclesiae doctoris, a die 9 iunii ad diem 10 eiusdem mensis, necnon sanctae Hildegardis Bingensis, virginis et Ecclesiae doctoris, a die 17 septembris ad diem 19 eiusdem mensis (27 aprilis 2022; Prot. 240/22).

excerpt: Zamorensis, Hispania: Calendarium proprium (19 dec. 2022; Prot. 542/22).

summary_en: One-year ruling for 2022 only: for the Abbey of St Cecilia on the Isle of Wight (Abbatia Sanctae Caeciliae in Insula Vecta, England) the solemnity of Saint George, martyr, which falls in the Easter Octave and had already been transferred to 26 April 2022, is celebrated this year only on 27 April 2022; a single-abbey concession.
excerpt: Abbatiae Sanctae Caeciliae in Insula Vecta: celebratio, Octava Paschae occurente, sollemnitatis sancti Georgii, martyris, iam translata ad diem 26 mensis aprilis 2022, hoc anno tantummodo die 27 mensis aprilis 2022 (1 martii 2022; Prot. 114/22).

summary_en: For the Spiritual Family 'The Work' (Familia spiritualis 'Opus') the optional memorial of Saint Faustina Kowalska, virgin, is transferred from 5 to 3 October, and the optional memorials of Saint Denis, bishop, and companions, martyrs, and of Saint Leonard, priest, from 9 to 8 October. The date is printed as 7 nov. 2020 although the protocol is 559/22 (a probable misprint for 2022); recorded as printed.
excerpt: Familiae spiritualis “Opus”: translatio celebrationis memoriae ad libitum sanctae Faustinae Kowalska, virginis, a die 5 octobris ad diem 3 octobris et memoriae ad libitum sancti Dionysii, episcopi, et sociorum, martyrum atque sancti Leonardi, presbyteri, a die 9 octobris ad diem 8 octobris (7 nov. 2020; Prot. 559/22).

summary_en: For the Papal Basilica of St Peter in the Vatican (Papalis Basilica Vaticana, Vatican City) the optional memorial of Blessed John Paul I, pope, is granted on 26 August in its proper calendar; a single-basilica concession. The same protocol number and date are printed on p. 444 for the Nuoro transfer of Saint Zephyrinus, so one of the two references is probably a misprint.
excerpt: Papalis Basilicae Vaticanae, Civitas Vaticana: 26 augusti, beati Ioannis Pauli I, papae, memoria ad libitum in Calendario proprio (18 nov. 2022; Prot. 580/22).

summary_en: For the Congregation of the Franciscan Sisters Handmaids of the Cross two celebrations are granted: Blessed Elżbieta Czacka, virgin and foundress, on 19 May, and the commemoration of the deceased sisters of the Congregation on 5 November; no rank is printed.
excerpt: Congregationis Sororum Franciscalium Ancillarum Crucis: 19 maii, beatae Elisabeth Czacka, virginis et fundatricis, et 5 novembris, commemoratio defunctorum sororum Congregationis (29 martii 2022; Prot. 96/22).

excerpt: Proprium Missarum et Liturgiae Horarum in honorem sancti Caesaris De Bus, presbyteri et fundatoris, necnon Calendarium proprium (10 oct. 2022; Prot. 144/22).

summary_en: For the Society of Jesus the celebrations of Blessed Johann Philipp Jeningen, priest, and Blessed Giovanni Antonio Solinas, priest and martyr, are inserted into the celebrations of 16 November, which are henceforth titled: the first, Sts Bernardino Realino, John Francis Régis and Francesco de Geronimo, and Blesseds Julien Maunoir, Antonio Baldinucci, Tiburcio Arnáiz and Johann Philipp Jeningen, priests; the second, Sts Roque González, Alfonso Rodríguez and Juan del Castillo and Blessed Giovanni Antonio Solinas, priests and martyrs (the text-approval line for the same protocol on pp. 435-436 and 441 is not recorded).
excerpt: celebrationes beati Ioannis Philippi Jeningen, presbyteri et beati Ioannis Antonii Solinas, presbyteri et martyris, inseruntur in celebrationes die 16 novembris, et exinde prior celebratio titulo sanctorum beatorum Bernardini Realino, Ioannis Francisci Régis et Francisci de Geronimo, et beatorum Iuliani Maunoir, Antonii Baldinucci, Tiburtii Arnáiz et Ioannis Philippi Jeningen, presbyterorum et martyrum altera sanctorum Rochi González, Alphonsi Rodriguez et Ioannis del Castillo; beati Ioannis Antonii Solinas, presbyterorum (16 nov. 2022; Prot. 564/22).

summary_en: Blessed Stefan Wyszyński (printed 'Wysyznski'), bishop, is confirmed as patron of the town of Legionowo, diocese of Warszawa-Praga (Varsaviensis-Pragensis, Poland); a single-town patronage.
excerpt: Beatus Stephanus Wysyznski, episcopus: Patronus apud Deum oppidi v.d. Legionowo, Varsaviensis-Pragensis, Polonia (21 aprilis 2022; Prot. 208/22).

summary_en: Blessed Stefan Wyszyński (printed 'Wysyznski'), bishop, is confirmed as patron of the town of Świdnik, archdiocese of Lublin (Lublinensis, Poland); a single-town patronage.
excerpt: Beatus Stephanus Wysyznski, episcopus: Patronus apud Deum oppidi v.d. Świdnik, Lublinensis, Polonia (18 nov. 2022; Prot. 531/22).

summary_en: Saint Rita, religious, is confirmed as patroness of the parish of St Mary Major in the town of Neocastrum (oppidum Neocastrense), diocese Neocastrensis, Italy; a single-parish patronage.
excerpt: Sancta Rita, religiosa: Patrona apud Deum paroeciae sanctae Mariae Maioris in oppido Neocastrensi, Neocastrensis, Italia (12 oct. 2022; Prot. 285/22).

summary_en: Saint John the Baptist is confirmed as patron of the town of Tres Cantos, archdiocese of Madrid (Matritensis, Spain); a single-town patronage.
excerpt: Sanctus Ioannes Baptista: Patronus apud Deum pagi v.d. Tres Cantos, Matritensis, Hispania (2 iunii 2022; Prot. 298/21).

summary_en: Saint John Bosco, priest, is confirmed as patron of the 'Associazione Nazionale degli ispettori del lavoro e degli ispettori tecnici del lavoro' (national association of labour inspectors) in Italy; an association's patronage.
excerpt: Sanctus Ioannes Bosco, presbyter: Patronus apud Deum Consociationis v.d. Associazione Nazionale degli ispettori del lavoro e degli ispettori tecnici del lavoro, Italia (12 apr. 2022; Prot. 307/21).

summary_en: Saint Nicholas, bishop, is confirmed as patron of the town of Głogów, diocese of Zielona Góra-Gorzów (Viridimontanensis-Gorzoviensis, Poland); a single-town patronage.
excerpt: Sanctus Nicolaus, episcopus: Patronus apud Deum oppidi v.d. Głogów, Viridimontanensis- Gorzoviensis, Polonia (25 maii 2022; Prot. 133/22).
